episodes.synopsis: “Once, people staked their youth on the seas.  On the Seven Seas, the flames of romanticism, ambition, adventure, and aspiration burned and clashed.  Now, young people of the year AD 2200 challenge the sea of stars.  What awaits them there is a world beyond our imagination.”
episodes.title: Galactic Clash

episodes.synopsis: "Having used teamwork to barely ward-off the enemy’s attack, the Rugger Team sets about exploring the planet.  But the shadow of fear still lies in wait."
episodes.title: The Isolated Regiment

episodes.synopsis: "The Galactic Survey Team has found an inhabitable planet, and the enemy persistently attacks them.  Will they really be able to fully protect this planet?"
episodes.title: Farewell, Achilles

episodes.synopsis: "The Rugger Guard picks-up a distress call from an electrically unstable space region and sends Keats Team to the rescue.  But there, they find a Galveston trap."
episodes.title: Rescue Mission To Hell

episodes.synopsis: "The Rugger Guard arrives at a planet where no creatures seem likely to live.  But while exploring there, Walther Team discovers a strange group of plants."
episodes.title: Battle For the Experiment Planet

episodes.synopsis: "A Galveston fleet mercilessly attacks the Rugger Guard, which was damaged in a meteor shower.  Can Aki and the others overcome this crisis?”
episodes.title: Fall To the Meteor Shower

episodes.synopsis: "It will be three weeks until the reinforcement fleet from Earth rendezvous with the Rugger Guard.  Will Galveston just sit-back and watch?"
episodes.title: Annihilation Of the Reinforcement Fleet

episodes.synopsis: "Yin and Yang, two worlds that make-up a tandem system.  There we encounter a ghost fleet, eerily cruising along.  Are they friend or foe?"
episodes.title: Specters Of the Binary System

episodes.synopsis: "At space time 6:00, the Earth support fleet that is to rendezvous with the Rugger Guard is attacked by a Galveston fleet.  Aki and team hear of it, and their anger explodes."
episodes.title: The Glorious Suicide Corps

episodes.synopsis: “Planet Six:  an eerie swarm of bats and a city of ruins.  What did Chakker see there, and why is his fever so high?”
episodes.title: Sneak Attack On the Space Fortress

episodes.synopsis: “A Galveston fighter crashes nearby as the Rugger Team investigates the ruined city.  The young pilot’s pride clashes violently with the team.”
episodes.title: A Momentary Truce

episodes.synopsis: “Kreuz spends a short time on a planet with a long history of slow death.  Here, he’s reminded of his childhood days.”
episodes.title: Legend Of the Space Forest

episodes.synopsis: “It’s been eight months since they left Earth.  Galveston has attacked them again and again.  What’s the suspicion within the mind of the exhausted Commander Ise?”
episodes.title: The Enemy Within the Mind

episodes.synopsis: “The Galveston Empire has caused a lot of trouble for the Rugger Guard.  Earth’s government decides to send an allied fleet equipped with new weapons against them.”
episodes.title: The Earth Fleet’s Counterattack

episodes.synopsis: “A hail of bombs falls on the fifth planet.  Will the opportunity for dialogue between the Earth Federation and the Galveston Empire be destroyed in the darkness of space?”
episodes.title: Breakdown Of the Space Talks

episodes.synopsis: “Within Galveston, judgment has been passed on the peace-inclined Teles.  Meanwhile, the Rugger Guard refuses to follow orders from Earth headquarters.”
episodes.title: The Two Rebellions

episodes.synopsis: “The Rugger Guard’s Captain Asimov has been ordered to return to Earth.  Will they have to fight, or is there still a peaceful solution left?”
episodes.title: Orders For Asimov’s Return

episodes.synopsis: “Ise and Aki take command on the bridge, carrying-on the will of Captain Asimov.  To that end, a joint planetary survey with Galveston is now underway.  However....”
episodes.title: A Touch-and-Go Situation

episodes.synopsis: “Planet K.  There Aki and team find signs of an advanced civilization.  But will it prove to be meaningless?”
episodes.title: Red Moon Rising

episodes.synopsis: “Lafitte is furious about the Earth Fleet building a base on Planet K.  Drive out the Earth fleet!  Lafitte launches his assault!”
episodes.title: Desperate Struggle For Planet K

episodes.synopsis: “Their red moon supply base cruelly destroyed, Galaxy Garrison Headquarters chooses to fight to defend Earth’s peace.  What will the Rugger Guard do?”
episodes.title: Arise, Galaxy Garrison

episodes.synopsis: “The conflict between Earth and Galveston continues to escalate.  Now, Commander Teles, a peace sympathizer, is dismissed from his post.”
episodes.title: Ex-Commander Teles

episodes.synopsis: “Retake Planet K!  Drake dies valiantly in the line of duty.  How far will this war escalate?”
episodes.title: The Mission To Recapture Planet K

episodes.synopsis: “Drake is dead.  When Teles returns alone to his homeworld he finds a ruined metropolis and a raging populace.”
episodes.title: Riot On Galveston

episodes.synopsis: “Aki Team, the galactic survey’s advance party, encounters a planet emitting a mysterious light.  The planet’s already in Galveston’s clutches, however.”
episodes.title: Bitter Struggle On the Planet Of Light

episodes.synopsis: “During its travels, the Rugger Guard discovers a Galveston missile base on Planet L.  But what awaits the Rugger Team when they go to investigate?”
episodes.title: The Snare Of the Hell Planet

episodes.synopsis: “In the wake of Teles’s dismissal, Galveston is now launching a direct attack on Earth’s space fortress.  Will Earth be able to hold-back the fierce attack?”
episodes.title: Storming the Space Fortress

episodes.synopsis: “As the Rugger Guard continues its advance, confronting it is the mysterious planet Eldora.  Queen Xuneau suddenly attacks Aki Team.”
episodes.title: Eldora's Plea

episodes.synopsis: “The men of Eldora have been working at a Galveston space fort.  But when they learn of the death of Queen Xuneau, their anger explodes.”
episodes.title: Uprising At the Space Fort

episodes.synopsis: “On its way to the enemy’s front line base, the Rugger Guard receives word of a crisis on Earth.  Aki and the others are powerless to stop the enemy fleet as it invades above the megalopolis.”
episodes.title: Earth’s State Of Emergency

episodes.synopsis: “The Rugger Team has survived increasingly violent attacks by Galveston.  What do they see when they emerge from the asteroid belt?”
episodes.title: Locate Enemy Headquarters

episodes.synopsis: “After a tough fight, the Rugger Team finally succeeds in destroying the front line base.  The price they pay, though, is much too great.”
episodes.title: Destruction Of the Front Line Base

episodes.synopsis: “The Rugger Guard crushed the enemy front line base.  Now, a new allied fleet has been dispatched to her with former Rugger Guard captain Dick Asimov in command.”
episodes.title: The New Allied Fleet To the Rescue

episodes.synopsis: “Teles was relieved of his post as Galveston front-line commander.  In order to find an inhabitable planet, he and his adjutant, Sirk, have been building a new survey base.”
episodes.title: Planet Of the Burning Cave

episodes.synopsis: “The Rugger Team gets some long-awaited letters from Earth.  But Mutsu is the only one who doesn’t get any, and he can’t bring himself to deploy with the others.”
episodes.title: Get Yourself Together, Mutsu

episodes.synopsis: “Ise goes alone to a primeval planet to negotiate a truce with Galveston.  But behind it all lurks Captain Raucher’s devious trap.”
episodes.title: A Desperate Undersea Combining

episodes.synopsis: “On Planet J, the people have advanced science.  Aki and the team try to survey this planet that Galveston considers Evil.”
episodes.title: Air Rugger Vanishes

episodes.synopsis: “The great pilot Emma sets-out personally with a scouting party.  Now begins a counter-offensive to win back the loss at Planet J with her pride on the line.”
episodes.title: Emma, the Female Captain

episodes.synopsis: “The Rugger Team enjoys a momentary bond through rugby with captured Galveston soldiers.  But then, a Galveston fleet attacks.”
episodes.title: The Tears Of a Rugby Player

episodes.synopsis: “On a planet brimming over with green, we meet Denon.  The Rugger Team enjoys a brief peaceful respite.  But the clutches of evil seize this place, too.”
episodes.title: The Boy Denon and the Elk

episodes.synopsis: “Galveston nears the time of its collapse.  Teles receives word about an inhabitable planet.  However, Raucher harbors his own ambitions.”
episodes.title: Discovery Of the New World

episodes.synopsis: “The Galveston and Earth fleets continue their survey of the third planet as they keep each other in check.  But Teles’s wishes are in vain, as the first shots are fired.”
episodes.title: Impending Crisis On the Inhabitable Planet

episodes.synopsis: “With the survival of his people depending upon migrating to the third planet, Teles holds peace talks with Asimov.  But a report comes in about native people already living there.”
episodes.title: Teles and Asimov

episodes.synopsis: “Galveston dismisses Teles for abandoning the third planet.  In order to destroy the Earth fleet, the new commander, Raucher, lays a trap for the Rugger Team.”
episodes.title: Aki Team Gets Caught

episodes.synopsis: “The Rugger Team is on its way to the Galveston homeworld, but contact between them and the garrison on the third planet is completely cut-off.  Aki goes back there immediately, and what does he find?”
episodes.title: Defend the Third Planet

episodes.synopsis: “New commander Raucher won’t abandon his ambition to invade the third planet.  The Rugger Team finally launches a general offensive against the Galveston planetary survey base.”
episodes.title: The Fall Of the Survey Base

episodes.synopsis: “Now that the Earth fleet has located the Galveston homeworld, it prepares for its final battle.  Meanwhile, Galveston launches its newest weapon, the Space Impulse.”
episodes.title: The Invisible Super Weapon

episodes.synopsis: “The Rugger Team finally infiltrated the Galveston star system.  This encourages Aki, but a fierce Galveston counter-attack is in his way.”
episodes.title: Get Past the Tenth Planet

episodes.synopsis: “The Earth fleet finally succeeded in getting past the tenth planet.  Aki, your target lies beyond the asteroid belt:  Planet Galveston!”
episodes.title: Entering the Final Zone Of Defense

episodes.synopsis: “The Earth fleet finally brings the fight to Galveston itself.  In the midst of the fierce battle, Sirk’s group rises-up in an attempt to rescue Teles.”
episodes.title: The Struggle For Galveston

episodes.synopsis: “Its back against the wall, Galveston Headquarters vows to go down fighting.  But the flames of revolution are ignited by the hands of citizens led by Teles.”
episodes.title: Fierce Battle In the Underground City

episodes.synopsis: “The Galveston Empire has finally collapsed.  Who will save the inhabitants of this dying planet?  Aki’s left with only one choice.”
episodes.title: Galactic Dawn
